title: Case-File Binder Composer
description: Composes a signed, Merkle-rooted case-file binder manifest over a caller-supplied set of heterogeneous receipts (OCG artifacts, chain composites, disclosure manifests, Helm bundle signposts, anchor proofs). A manifest-of-manifests: never ingests file contents, never re-verifies a referenced receipt, only indexes it by digest with a hint for where to check it.

prev_binder.description: Optional prior binder manifest to diff and chain against

mcp_tool_definition.name: build_casefile_binder
mcp_tool_definition.description: Builds a signed Merkle-rooted case-file binder manifest from a caller-supplied list of heterogeneous receipt references. The agent supplies {kind,ref_label,digest,verify_hint} entries; the worker never sees receipt contents. Returns the binder object and Merkle root.
